title: Corrected restatement of frozen crypto-carry-decay: deterministic accounting repair, not a rescue and not a new validation candidate

restatement_not_candidate.purpose: Honest non-candidate restatement after the frozen engine failed its read-only accounting audit (CarryAccountingReview, 2026-08-29). No winner is re-selected; no prospective alpha is claimed; the original pre-registered 15% funding-yield gate remains binding and is reported as FAILED.
restatement_not_candidate.relationship_to_frozen_candidate: The frozen candidate (sha256 dc596e477... run.py, fb1c9f94... strategy.json, bc131e5e... trials.json, 3935135b... returns.csv) is untouched and remains hash-frozen. This directory only recomputes the same frozen rule with confirmed defects repaired, and reports the result as a retrospective diagnostic.
restatement_not_candidate.why_status_is_not_validation_pass: The corrected mechanism fails its own pre-registered first falsification gate (12.48% < 15% on actual short notional in 2024), and under the contract's fully funded constraint the rule terminates by margin call in Dec-2020 and holds nothing thereafter. Historical-confirmation access is deliberate inspection, so holdout_accessed=true and validation-pass is unreachable in principle for this restatement.

mechanism: Unconditional always-on equal-weight BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT 1:1 spot-long / USD-M-perp-short carry (frozen rule, unchanged signal). CORRECTED accounting: (1) exact signed funding - the short receives +r*notional when r>0 and PAYS when r<0, no max(rate,0) clip, fail on duplicate snapped events; (2) all per-notional yields normalize by the actual short notional |q_p|*P over held hours, never equity/2; (3) fully funded entry - independent USD-M margin collateral equal to 100% of entry short notional posted from sleeve equity, spot principal bought with the remainder, entry gross (spot+perp notional) = 2N <= NAV exactly, zero borrowing, fresh 2%-of-sleeve isolation buffer, exchange-style liquidation at 0.5% maintenance of current notional (margin call terminates the sleeve; no top-up, no cross-collateral); (4) SOFR benchmark accrues carried-forward daily rate on every calendar day, ACT/360; collateral and idle cash earn zero interest (conservative). Frozen rules preserved: 50/50 initial split, next-bar execution, funding credited only to positions held at the event instant, 12/7 bps one-way fees with 2x stress doubling.

holdout_access_justification: Per assignment: the confirmation window is now intentionally inspected as a retrospective diagnostic after the frozen report was invalidated; per protocol-amendment.json it is parameter-embargoed confirmation, never an epistemically blind holdout, and it cannot establish prospective alpha.
trial_note: The four pre-declared rebalance variants (0/24/168/720h) were all recomputed under corrected accounting. Entry-and-hold remains the frozen-rule restatement; the other three are comparison diagnostics only. No new variant, threshold, or sizing rule was searched.

parameters.signal: unconditional always-on 1:1 basis carry, equal-weight BTC/ETH (frozen, unchanged)

signal_timing: Unconditional rule; entry fills at the first tradable common bar open after data start (next-bar); funding credited only to positions held at the event instant (entry orders at the same open fill after the snapshot); windows are slices of one continuous accounting path from 2020-08-01.

cost_model.application: one-way taker incl. slippage on traded notional at entries, rebalance opens, final/margin-call liquidation; 2x stress doubles every fee; funding is income with exact sign, never a cost line; no interest earned on cash

benchmark.name: SOFR cash, carried forward across all calendar days, ACT/360
benchmark.correction: The frozen benchmark earned zero on 116 calendar days in 2024 (weekends/holidays); APPLIED-365-style zero-accrual is replaced by NY-Fed carry-forward with ACT/360, which raises 2024 benchmark return from the reported 3.52% to ~5.15% annualized.

corrected_engine.note: Under the fully funded constraint (independent 100% collateral, margin call on 0.5%-maintenance breach, no borrowing) the corrected always-on rule cannot survive the Dec-2020 BTC advance: BTC sleeve margin-called 2020-12-17 16:00 UTC, ETH sleeve 2020-12-30 19:00 UTC. Both sleeves sit in cash from then on. Development shows only the surviving Aug-Dec 2020 carry; validation and historical confirmation show an empty position.

invalidity_causes: D1 run.py:152 max(rate,0.0) clipped every standalone negative funding rate (2024: removed 92 BTC + 46 ETH negative payments, overstating funding by 0.00722824 + 0.00427122 USD per initial dollar; 2020-2024 fixed-path cumulative overstatement ~0.1877)

D2 run.py:518 yields divided by equity/2 (mean denominators 0.813293 BTC / 1.279368 ETH) instead of actual |q_p|*P (2.899141 / 4.385734): reported 45.0%/47.9% are ~3.5x inflated; corrected 2024 yields are 12.38% BTC / 13.87% ETH (pair 13.13% simple / 13.28% dollar-weighted)

D3 run.py:356-364 entry spent the whole sleeve in spot with cash exactly 0 and reserved no USD-M margin: entry gross 4K = 1.9962 per 1.0 NAV (~2.0x), 2024 mean gross/equity 3.475 with mean combined negative cash -6.00 USD per initial dollar - borrowing, not fully funded; the contract requires total gross <= 1.0x NAV at entry with independent cash collateral
D4 run.py:448 sofr.get(d, 0.0) accrued zero on 116 of 366 days in 2024 and used /365; carry-forward ACT/360 gives 5.15% vs reported 3.52%, cutting 2024 excess by ~1.7 points before any other fix

corrected_2024_arithmetic_bounds_frozen_.note: holding the FROZEN position/sizing fixed and applying only the arithmetic repairs (signed funding, actual-notional yield denominators, carry-forward ACT/360 SOFR) - the reviewer's recomputation bounds, which this restatement confirms from raw data
corrected_2024_arithmetic_bounds_frozen_.excess_cum_2024_remaining_positive: +22.41% survives arithmetic repair ONLY because the position still embeds ~2x gross, zero independent collateral, and unlimited cross-margin credit (see D3) - economically inadmissible under the contract
corrected_2024_arithmetic_bounds_frozen_.reviewer_margin_feasibility_notes: with a 1% maintenance requirement the 2024 path needs >= ~63.5% BTC collateral credit at the worst point; no-cross-collateral margin compliance fails; a ~23.6%/yr financing charge on the mean negative cash erases the 2024 excess

first_falsification_gate.spec: unchanged pre-registered rule: annualized mean funding income on short notional (BTC/ETH pair) must exceed 15%/yr on the 2024 validation year
first_falsification_gate.denominator_correction: actual |q_p|*P short notional (the gate's intended meaning); computed on raw signed funding rates the pair earns 12.48%/yr (BTC 11.96%, ETH 13.00% raw-sum basis; 12.38%/13.87% on the frozen fixed quantity path) - every defensible value < 15%

next-bar execution preserved; funding attributed only to positions held at the event instant
duplicate snapped funding events raise (none in audited archives)

determinism: identical runs produce byte-identical returns.csv/report.json (verified)
risks: The corrected engine models isolated margin at 100% initial / 0.5% maintenance with a 2% sleeve buffer; different margin tiers change the termination date, not the direction: at any collateral level consistent with 'independent cash collateral, no borrowing', a 1:1 short with spot unhedged-collateral cannot withstand a sustained spot advance using 0.5x-equity capital

Portfolio-margin or spot-as-collateral regimes could keep the trade alive but are explicitly out of scope (contract forbids cross-collateral assumptions; unmodeled haircuts/financing would be required to make any claim)
Exchange default/depeg/liquidation-cascade risk remains unmodeled and unbounded
The frozen report's +23% 2024 excess does not survive repair UNLESS its ~2x-gross, zero-collateral position is allowed, which violates the campaign's no-leverage/no-borrowing contract
next_experiment: None within this restatement: the pre-registered gate failed, the mechanism is not deployable as specified, and no rescue or parameter search is authorized. If the carry-complex family is revisited in a future wave, it requires a redesigned, margin-compliant specification registered before any new data access, and the prospective forward shadow (from 2026-08-29) is the only genuine untouched evidence.
